subject: Multi-year NFI held-out evaluation, step 6: inference on the frozen set
description: Tobias gave the go on 2026-10-27, after the freeze record (#112, 88e8920; manifest sha256 daaa428754aa4acfd832d9cc0fe5a0acb60e86ade2b511699f1181732697ff2c) landed: 'build + one-cell probe'. Scope: a k8s Job that runs scripts/validate_against_nfi.py in frozen mode (--holdout-manifest, --cell, --expected-manifest-sha256, --dump-per-plot) in the sealed ladder-crop-distill image the freeze used (sha-4cb93b4), so the dumps carry the provenance score_nfi_holdout.py verifies; a one-cell timing probe on one GPU with read-only PVC and no metrics printed; then GPU hardware and hours for the 28 cells (7 models x rungs 1-4) put to Tobias, whose decision it is. Not in scope until he decides: the 28-cell run, dump writes to the PVC, NMD scoring (score_nfi_holdout.py). No edits to NFI_SOURCE_FILES (the scorer re-hashes them against the manifest). No NFI tile names or coordinates in tracked files. Review: Codex.
